title: 7.21.3 Challenges: Make it yours
description: Your Quest is complete. Change one thing of your own: a fourth enemy kind, a special move with a cooldown, or a shop that spends gold. Pick one; add an idea of your own on top if you like.

steps.title: Set JOIN back to ''
steps.instructions: Your finished game from 7.20.3 is in the editor. If you joined a classmate's duel there, your `JOIN` line still holds that room's code, and Run would join that old, finished duel instead of the campaign. Make sure the line reads `const JOIN = '';` so the game starts on the campaign. Run: the top says Fight 1 of 3.
hints: H still hosts a new duel whenever you want one; JOIN is only for joining.

steps.title: Pick a challenge and build it
steps.instructions:
Choose one of these three challenges. The check turns green when any one of them is in your code, so one is enough. An idea of your own is welcome on top of it. Start from your finished game in the editor.

**Challenge 1: a fourth enemy (easy).** In `KINDS`, after the Ogre's line, add a fourth kind: `{ name: 'Dragon', hp: 44, power: 8, potions: 2, color: 'crimson' },`. Run and play: there are four fights now, and the strip says `Fight 1 of 4`. Then give it something new: in `fightOver`, below the line `message = 'Level up! Next: ' + fighters[1].name + '. Your turn';`, add `if (which === enemies.length - 1) message = 'Level up! Final fight: ' + fighters[1].name + '. Your turn';`. To reach it quickly, set every kind's `hp` to `1` for one Run, then put the numbers back.

**Challenge 2: a special move with a cooldown (medium).** Below `let duel = false;`, add `let cooldown = 0;`, and in `newGame()`, `cooldown = 0;`. In `draw()`'s key block, below the line for key 3: `if (kb.presses('4') && cooldown === 0) a = 4;`. In `act`, right after `const them = fighters[1 - t];`, count your turns down: `if (t === 0 && cooldown > 0) cooldown -= 1;`. Below the line for action 3, the power hit: `if (a === 4) { message = me.name + ' power-hits ' + them.name + ' for ' + me.attack(them, me.power + roll); cooldown = 3; }`. In `drawTop()`, show it under the message: `if (!duel) text(cooldown === 0 ? '4: power hit ready' : '4: power hit in ' + cooldown, 300, 46, 12, 'gold');`. A power hit does twice your power, plus the roll.

**Challenge 3: a shop that spends gold (hard).** Below `let duel = false;`, add `let gold = 0;`, and in `newGame()`, `gold = 0;`. In `fightOver`, on the line before `which += 1;`, earn it: `gold += 10;`. In `draw()`'s key block, below the line for key 3, the shop: `if (kb.presses('5') && gold >= 10) { gold -= 10; fighters[0].potions += 1; message = 'You buy a potion. Your turn'; }`. Buying does not use up your turn. In `drawTop()`: `if (!duel) text('gold ' + gold + '   5: buy a potion (10)', 300, 46, 12, 'gold');`.
hints: Whatever you pick, play the whole run afterwards, lose once, and press R.
Challenge 1 changes no rule: `enemies.length` already counts the new kind, so the run grows by itself.
Online, nothing changes: `goodMove` still only lets actions 1 to 3 through, so the duel stays fair.

requirements.title: You changed one thing about the game
requirements.description: Any one challenge turns this green: a fourth kind with real numbers added to the list the enemies are made from, a special move on key 4 whose cooldown is set when it is used and counted down, or gold that buys something only when there is enough. Help: 7.19.1 (Reading: Kinds as data, map, and levelling up)
